origin_note: standing feet rest on row y=56 (outline at 57); body centred on x=32. Death/decay corpses lie between y~44 and y~60, fully inside the 64x64 cell.

palette.index_rule: index = 1 + slot_position*4 + level; 0 = transparent; level 0 highlight,1 mid,2 shadow,3 outline

fx_parts.pool: blood pool under the corpse (death 8-9, decay)

canvas_note: death and decay fit the standard 64x64 cell (no wider canvas needed); the corpse lies roughly x 8..56, y 40..60
decay_note: 'decay' is the reading of 'decoy': corpse rotting after death. Self-contained: decay branches in skel.py + L_fx; rename via ANIMS/ORDER_ANIMS/FPS.
anchor_note: anchors per frame in sprite pixels: head centre, mouth (bite point), chest (hit point / blood source), hand_A (reaching arm), hand_B, pelvis, feet
